title: Built-in Guest Account is Enabled
description: The built-in Guest account allows unauthenticated access to the local machine and network shares.
impact: Anonymous users or network attackers can authenticate without a password.
remediation_guidance: Disable Guest account: Disable-LocalUser -Name 'Guest' or net user Guest /active:no

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure 'Accounts: Guest account status' is set to 'Disabled'

title: Built-in Administrator Account is Active Without Renaming
description: The well-known SID (RID 500) Administrator account is heavily targeted by automated credential-stuffing and brute-force attacks.
impact: Attackers can perform targeted password brute-forcing against the known username 'Administrator'.
remediation_guidance: Disable built-in Administrator: Disable-LocalUser -Name 'Administrator' and use dedicated administrative accounts with UAC.

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure 'Accounts: Administrator account status' is set to 'Disabled'

title: Account Lockout Threshold is Not Configured (Brute-Force Vulnerable)
description: Account lockout threshold determines how many consecutive failed logon attempts are permitted before locking an account.
expected: Lockout threshold between 3 and 5 failed attempts
impact: Attackers can conduct unlimited online password guessing and dictionary attacks without triggering lockouts.

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure 'Account lockout threshold' is set to '5 or fewer invalid logon attempts'
